findings.title: Header Regenerate button and stale banner action have no zero-credits guard
findings.description: When totalRemaining is 0, clicking Regenerate (header) or the stale banner action calls handleGenerate, which the backend rejects. The user sees a generic error toast with no path to buy credits. The empty/failed states correctly degrade to the buy-credits pattern via renderCreditsAction, but the succeeded state bypasses this. The spec says 'When credits are zero and a generate action would be shown, show the existing buy-credits pattern' -- Regenerate is a generate action.
findings.recommendation: Add a credit check to both the header Regenerate button and the stale banner action. When totalRemaining is 0, show the buy-credits pattern (admin link or non-admin modal) instead of the generate action.

findings.title: Infinite redirect loop when feature flag toggles off while user is on /ai tab
findings.description: The useEffect sets currentViewPath to 'ai' when the user visits the AI tab. When isAiEnabled becomes false, the effect re-runs but does not clear currentViewPath (the if block doesn't execute because 'ai' is no longer in possiblePaths). currentViewPath stays 'ai'. The redirector redirects to /ai. The /ai Route is gone (conditional). No route matches. Infinite redirect loop.
findings.recommendation: Add an else branch: if currentView is not in possiblePaths, reset currentViewPath to 'overview'. This handles the flag-toggle and bookmark-with-disabled-flag edge cases.
